properties.name: AM TURM
properties.remarks: Usually, reliable lift can be found at this point in summer time.

properties.name: BAD NEUSTADT STEINBRUCH
properties.remarks: Stone quarry lies inside traffic pattern of airfield Neustadt-Saale!

properties.name: BASF CHEMICAL PLANT
properties.remarks: Best centered when you smell it :)

properties.name: BIELEFELD DEPONIE
properties.remarks: Thermal  at South Side of Teutoburger Wald!

properties.name: BOTTENHORN TV-TOWER
properties.remarks: You may find the thermal also somewhat north-east from the TV-Tower.

properties.name: BRUCHHAUSEN, WOODS AT VILSA-PLANT
properties.remarks: The wood marks a slightly elevated area that frequently triggers thermals, even in the late afternoon it is a good spot for reaching final glide altitude, when surrounding thermals already fade. Exact location must be adjusted according to current wind.

properties.name: DIE GLASHÜTTE
properties.remarks: One of the best thermals you can get here in Lünen! Our members at the gliding club call it "Glashütte" named by the factory which is located here.

properties.name: DORMAGEN CHEMICAL PLANT
properties.remarks: Lift will usually be found in the south west corner of the chemical plant, but this may vary depending on wind.

properties.name: GIENGEN BRENZ
properties.remarks: Bei Süd/Westwinden löst der Hang aus

properties.name: GUNDREMMINGEN AKW
properties.remarks: Beware of heavy turbulences

properties.name: HAMBACH COAL CONVEYOR BELT JUNCTION
properties.remarks: This is the junction of the coal conveyor belts. It is the most reliable place to find a thermal in the otherwise thermally weak region between the two powerplants Weisweiler and Fortuna.

properties.name: DÜSE
properties.remarks: Best spot is where the fields extend into the woods.

properties.name: HABSBERG
properties.remarks: Reliable thermal source. Outlanding field below in the narrow valley of St. Blasien. Entry height should be 1.500mNN or higher.

properties.name: HOCKENHEIM MOTODROM
properties.remarks: Beware of restricted area on race event!

properties.name: HOTZENWALD HAUSBART
properties.remarks: Very reliable in the afternoon. Watch out for glider and paraglider traffic in the area!

properties.name: HÖNNINGEN
properties.remarks: Thermal typically used by paraglider pilots flying at Hönningen. Thermal starts quite narrow.

properties.name: LOECHERBERG1
properties.remarks: First thermal in the morning.

properties.name: MARBURG LAHNBERGE
properties.remarks: Position may vary a little on the ridge to the north or south.

properties.name: MAROLDSWEISACH, STEINBRUCH
properties.remarks: Basaltsteinbruch.

properties.name: MERKUR
properties.remarks: Merkur Paragliding Takeoff with reliable thermals. Sometimes thermals will develop a bit more to the west near the landing site, so if low, search there.

properties.name: NORDHELLE
properties.remarks: This hotspot refers to the whole ridge including both towers.

properties.name: OBERAUERBRUNST-HAUSBART
properties.remarks: Erster erreichbarer Bart vom Haushang in Unteroewssen.

properties.name: ROTHENBERG WESTERN SLOPE
properties.remarks: Good last thermal if you plan to final glide to an airfield in the so called Rheingraben.

properties.name: SCHOLVEN POWERPLANT
properties.remarks: give attention to the airspace Düsseldorf!

properties.name: SCHRIESHEIM QUARRY
properties.remarks: Beware of hang-gliders and paragliders. Works best on a gentle western breeze. On strong wind conditions, ridge soaring is possible along this ridge.

properties.name: START 30
properties.remarks:
Mögliche Auslösung der gesamten Hangkante entlang.
Achtung F.-W.-Betrieb.

properties.name: STENDAL-BORSTEL AIRFIELD
properties.remarks: The area around the concrete runway, the hangars and the pine woods south of the runway are a reliable source of thermals. Please check with Stendal-Info on 122.405 for any traffic in the pattern when approaching the airfield.

properties.name: STUKENBROCK BAGGERSEE
properties.remarks: Nice Thermal most on North side of Lake.

properties.name: VIELBRUNN FELGENWALD
properties.remarks: Two windmills 3 km south of Vielbrunn glider site, earth dump area nearby

properties.name: WALLDORF AUTOBAHN JUNCTION
properties.remarks: Best in cold weather conditions e.g. postfrontal.

properties.name: WEISSER STEIN
properties.remarks: Good thermal to enter the Odenwald. Especially good and reliable before noon.
